اعتدلن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَلْنَ (iʕtadalna) /iʕ.ta.dal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# اِعْتَدِلْنَ (iʕtadilna) /iʕ.ta.dil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
